description: capafy-loop and life-manager-loop each have a test-loop.sh exercising their loop.sh's HEAL/error-path logic (payout-err->NA, stale->heal+req, never-ran, healthy->no-req, etc.), consistent with this repo's own TDD mandate. reddit-loop has NO test file at all for reddit-loop/loop.sh (glob of /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/self/reddit-loop/* shows only launchd/, state/, reddit-loop-healthcheck.sh, loop.sh, reddit-loop-cli.sh -- no test-loop.sh). This means the FIND-008 fix (posts-freshness guard, loop.sh:28-33) and the FIND-010 fix (safe count(), loop.sh:12-13) as applied to reddit-loop are entirely unverified by any automated test, unlike the equivalent capafy fixes which are asserted by capafy-loop/test-loop.sh. This is a pre-existing gap the fix pass did not close even while adding new untested logic to this exact file.
